task173_mass_binding.root_cause: V08 run_autonomous_nozzle_full_path builds equipment mass from bindings.normalized (perturbed case) but hydraulic post-pass and Task174 decomposition are frozen to the Task168 enumeration bundle (Task026/Task029 at nominal 12/20 kg/s). Mass-flow sensitivity sweeps raise ValueError/ValidationError in the R27 full-path bridge when equipment totals diverge from admitted structural hydraulic templates. Temperature-only sweeps retain nominal mass and may compute high-K prescreen dp.
